summary: The gyomu-cli package serves as the primary command-line interface for the application, built using Typer. It orchestrates user commands, coordinates code snapshot execution, and integrates configuration settings for AI and routing services by leveraging various core domain and infrastructure packages.
responsibilities: Provide the main user-facing command-line interface and application entry point.
Coordinate code snapshot requests and execution flow.
Initialize and register AI configurations and routing mechanisms.

capabilities.name: Command-Line Interface
capabilities.description: Defines the command-line interface entry points and top-level command routing for the application.

capabilities.name: Snapshot Execution
capabilities.description: Handles code snapshot execution and processing workflows.

capabilities.name: AI and Routing Configuration
capabilities.description: Configures integration with Google routing and AI-related services.

design_decisions: Built upon the Typer framework for declarative command-line application structure.
Integrates core domain functionality with specialized infrastructure, schema, workflow, and AI compiler packages.
usage_guidance: Use the main application instance to extend or invoke CLI commands.
Rely on the provided snapshot and configuration registration functions to wire up command execution and AI services.
